Interpretation (from the authors):
  • The ‑High variant removes high‑order retrieval, causing a notable drop in performance across most datasets and metrics.
  • The ‑Low variant removes low‑level retrieval, which hurts depth of detail but retains good comprehensiveness.
  • The ‑Origin variant eliminates the original text from retrieval; its performance remains comparable to the full system, sometimes even improving on certain datasets.
